summary: Complete testing of the enhanced questionnaire/simulator feature. All 12 test scenarios passed: questionnaire flow with 5 questions leads to EMAIL step (not directly to results), email validation (empty/invalid blocked, valid accepted), skip email functionality, results page displays correctly with urgency banner, PDF download, share buttons, action buttons. Backend POST /api/simulator/result works with all fields (email, droits, demarches, delais, prestation). Different scenarios produce different profiles and content (AT, MP, MDPH, Expertise, Assurance, Autre). HubSpot CRM sync is prepared but inactive (placeholder only).
passed_tests: Questionnaire flow: answering all 5 questions leads to EMAIL step (not directly to results)
Email step shows 'Votre rapport est prêt !' with email input, 'Recevoir mon rapport' button, and 'Passer cette étape' link
Email validation: empty email blocked with toast error
Email validation: invalid email (no @) blocked with toast error
Submitting valid email saves to backend POST /api/simulator/result and shows results
Backend returns success:true and result id on submission
Skipping email step ('Passer cette étape') still shows results
Results page shows: urgency banner (green/amber/red based on scenario)
Results page shows: PDF download card with 'Télécharger' button
PDF download button generates a PDF file (diagnostic-strategie-expertise-sante.pdf) - no crash
Results page shows: recommendations section
Results page shows: 'Vos droits potentiels' section
Results page shows: 'Démarches prioritaires' section with numbered steps
Results page shows: 'Délais importants' section
Results page shows: 'Prestations recommandées' section with prices
Share buttons visible: WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Copier le lien
Copy link button changes to 'Copié !' after click
Action buttons visible: 'Prendre rendez-vous', 'Nous contacter', 'Recommencer'
Backend POST /api/simulator/result accepts all fields: email, droits, demarches, delais, prestation
AT scenario produces profile 'Victime d'accident du travail' with AT-specific content
MP scenario produces profile 'Victime de maladie professionnelle' with MP-specific content
MDPH scenario produces profile 'Demande MDPH (Handicap)' with MDPH-specific content (AAH, RQTH, Cerfa)
Expertise scenario produces profile 'Préparation expertise médicale' with URGENT (red) urgency
Assurance scenario produces profile 'Litige assurantiel' with IMPORTANT urgency for long duration
Autre scenario produces profile 'Situation spécifique'
'Modifier mes réponses' button on email step returns to last question (Q5)
'Recommencer' button on results resets the entire questionnaire to Q1
Progress bar shows 0% at Q1, ~20% increments per question, 90% at email step, 100% at results
critical_code_review_comments: SimulateurPage.jsx: Well-implemented with proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
getResults() function correctly produces different profiles based on situation: at, mp, mdph, assurance, expertise, autre
Urgency levels correctly set: 'urgent' (red) for expertise, 'important' (amber) for refus/recours/long-duration, 'normal' (green) otherwise
PDF generation via jsPDF works correctly with site colors (#B94E48 accent), header band, profile box, sections, footer
Email validation in handleSubmitEmail correctly checks for @ symbol
Backend endpoint correctly stores droits, demarches, delais, prestation fields in MongoDB
HubSpot CRM sync code is present but inactive (HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID and HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN empty in .env)
seed_data_creation: Multiple simulator results created in MongoDB simulator_results collection with various scenarios (AT, MP, MDPH, Expertise, Assurance)

mocked_apis.note: HubSpot CRM sync is prepared but inactive (HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID and HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN are empty placeholders in backend/.env). When these are configured, the POST /api/simulator/result endpoint will attempt to create a HubSpot contact.
